meta.followup_status: 2026-10-17 follow-up round: 8 agents (Statafelshop navigation/operator/statafels; covers; print/bundles/B2B; service/shipping/UX; Outmate buizenframe matrix; Outmate furniture/lighting prices; Outmate account/search/footer; Outmate policies and easy-up box contents) all got 'web search budget is used up' and ran no query. Nothing was re-verified. This merge only adds already-sourced Outmate details from scratchpad research-raw.json and marks the asked-for values unconfirmed. Outmate facts used as Statafelshop proxies stay labelled shop 'outmate'. Second 2026-10-17 follow-up round: 8 more agents (Statafelshop covers/textiles; statafels, actiepakketten and trolleys; print, B2B and statafelshop.be; operator, service, shipping and UX; Outmate buizenframe and opslagtent matrix; Outmate furniture, lighting and heating prices plus existence checks; Outmate policies; Outmate easy-up box contents plus account/search/footer UX) were refused the same way and ran no query. That merge adds only already-sourced easy-up spec values from research-raw.json, new existence checks for the rerun (cadeaubon, outlet/B-keuze, kerstverlichting URL, floors beyond lopers), the Ultimate slug spelling, and Statafelshop trolley gaps. Rerun lesson: run the Statafelshop queries as one agent, first and alone, in a turn with a fresh budget, so parallel agents cannot use up the shared 200-search limit. Third 2026-10-17 follow-up round: 8 agents (Statafelshop operator, navigation and policies; Statafelshop statafels, textiles and trolleys; Statafelshop print, B2B and statafelshop.be; Outmate buizenframe and opslagtent matrix; Outmate category census and existence checks; Outmate furniture, lighting, heating and afzetpaal prices; Outmate policies, payment and offerte page; Outmate storefront UX, account and easy-up box contents) were all refused by the shared 200-search budget at their first query, so no query ran (the fourth Statafelshop attempt with no data). That merge only: maps 13 already-sourced but unmapped category URLs from scratchpad raw_cats.txt (11 new subcategories, 74 -> 85, plus alias_urls; see census_2026_10_17); logs 16 never-run checks in existence_checks; adds partytenten-buizenframe.size_line_matrix as a consolidated view of already-sourced cells; records the refusal on the asked features; folds in already-sourced footer, payment-method, facet-pattern and Premium seam facts; sharpens the furniture, lighting and afzetpaal gaps; and corrects the attempt counts. No reference_prices were added and no Statafelshop entry was created. Before any rerun, the owner must start a new turn (fresh budget) or raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION.
meta.census_2026_10_17: Category census follow-up: the shared WebSearch budget was already used up, so the first two census queries (product-categorie list, /alle/) were refused and no existence check ran. Done offline instead: diffed the 82 URLs in scratchpad raw_cats.txt (the task said 93; the file has 82, all also in research-raw.json) against the 74 subcategories. 13 URLs were unmapped. Added 11 subcategories with reference_url + confidence (own URL: opslag-pvc-classic/-premium/-professional, opslag-carport-pvc-professional, stretch-lusverbinding, barkruk-onderdelen, klaptafel-onderdelen, stoelen-onderdelen; name-only children stretch-koppelgoten, stretch-palensets, tuinpaviljoen-zijwanden); the other URLs are parents/aliases recorded as reference or alias_urls. Existence checks are logged in existence_checks with query_ran=false.
